description: This file defines a filter class for handling 'X-Sendfile' headers in a web server context, specifically for the lighttpd server. It creates a filter object, manages request/response handling, and integrates with the server's filtering mechanism to serve files efficiently.

classes.name: XFilterDrop
classes.description: A filter class that drops all input content, effectively discarding request body content.

methods.description: Constructor for creating a new instance of XFilterDrop.
